description: No source has negative generation
check_sql: SELECT country_key, year, source_key, generation_twh FROM dw.fact_generation_annual WHERE generation_twh < 0

description: Generation-mix shares sum to 100% ± 1 per country-year
check_sql: SELECT country_key, year, SUM(share_pct) AS share_sum FROM dw.fact_generation_annual GROUP BY country_key, year HAVING SUM(generation_twh) > 0 AND ABS(SUM(share_pct) - 100) > 1

description: No gaps in a country's year range
check_sql: SELECT country_key, MIN(year) AS first_year, MAX(year) AS last_year, COUNT(DISTINCT year) AS years FROM dw.fact_country_annual GROUP BY country_key HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT year) <> MAX(year) - MIN(year) + 1

description: A country's data ends before the latest year in the warehouse
check_sql: SELECT c.name, MAX(f.year) AS last_year FROM dw.fact_country_annual AS f JOIN dw.dim_country AS c ON c.country_key = f.country_key GROUP BY c.name HAVING MAX(f.year) < (SELECT MAX(year) FROM dw.fact_country_annual)

description: Generation mix sums to Ember's total generation within 0.5%
check_sql: SELECT f.country_key, f.year, SUM(f.generation_twh) AS mix_twh, ca.total_generation_twh FROM dw.fact_generation_annual AS f JOIN dw.fact_country_annual AS ca ON ca.country_key = f.country_key AND ca.year = f.year GROUP BY f.country_key, f.year, ca.total_generation_twh HAVING ca.total_generation_twh > 0 AND ABS(SUM(f.generation_twh) - ca.total_generation_twh) > 0.005 * ca.total_generation_twh

description: Computed renewable share is within 0.1 pp of Ember's own Renewables share
check_sql: SELECT ca.country_key, ca.year, ca.re_share_gen_pct, s.share_of_generation_pct FROM dw.fact_country_annual AS ca JOIN stg.ember_yearly AS s ON s.country_key = ca.country_key AND s.year = ca.year AND s.electricity_source = 'Renewables' WHERE ABS(ca.re_share_gen_pct - s.share_of_generation_pct) > 0.1

description: Every raw Ember row reaches staging (no unknown countries dropped)
check_sql: SELECT r.raw_rows, s.stg_rows FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS raw_rows FROM raw.ember_yearly) AS r CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS stg_rows FROM stg.ember_yearly) AS s WHERE r.raw_rows <> s.stg_rows

description: Malaysia total generation: Ember vs OWID within ±5% of the OWID value (known gap 2023-24, see docs/reconciliation.md)
check_sql: SELECT ca.year, ca.total_generation_twh AS ember_twh, o.electricity_generation AS owid_twh FROM dw.fact_country_annual AS ca JOIN dw.dim_country AS c ON c.country_key = ca.country_key AND c.is_focus = 1 JOIN stg.owid_energy AS o ON o.country_key = ca.country_key AND o.year = ca.year WHERE o.electricity_generation > 0 AND ABS(ca.total_generation_twh - o.electricity_generation) > 0.05 * o.electricity_generation

description: Carbon intensity equals emissions ÷ generation within 1%; flags a year with generation but only one of emissions or intensity
check_sql: SELECT country_key, year, emissions_intensity_gco2e_kwh, emissions_mtco2e FROM dw.fact_country_annual WHERE total_generation_twh > 0 AND ((emissions_mtco2e IS NULL AND emissions_intensity_gco2e_kwh IS NOT NULL) OR (emissions_mtco2e IS NOT NULL AND emissions_intensity_gco2e_kwh IS NULL) OR ABS(1000 * emissions_mtco2e / NULLIF(total_generation_twh, 0) - emissions_intensity_gco2e_kwh) > 0.01 * emissions_intensity_gco2e_kwh)

description: No source-year has a capacity factor above 100%
check_sql: SELECT f.country_key, f.year, f.source_key, 1000 * f.generation_twh / NULLIF(f.capacity_gw * y.hours_in_year, 0) AS capacity_factor FROM dw.fact_generation_annual AS f JOIN dw.dim_year AS y ON y.year = f.year WHERE f.capacity_gw > 0 AND 1000 * f.generation_twh > f.capacity_gw * y.hours_in_year

description: A mix source reports capacity but no generation (row would be dropped from the facts)
check_sql: SELECT country_key, year, electricity_source, capacity_gw FROM stg.ember_yearly WHERE include_in_mix = 1 AND capacity_gw > 0 AND generation_twh IS NULL

description: Malaysia total generation: Ember vs DOSM total supply within ±10% of the DOSM value (full years 2018-2023)
check_sql: SELECT ca.year, ca.total_generation_twh AS ember_twh, d.value_twh AS dosm_supply_twh FROM dw.fact_country_annual AS ca JOIN dw.dim_country AS c ON c.country_key = ca.country_key AND c.is_focus = 1 JOIN stg.dosm_annual AS d ON d.year = ca.year AND d.measure = 'supply' AND d.sector = 'total' AND d.months = 12 WHERE ABS(ca.total_generation_twh - d.value_twh) > 0.10 * d.value_twh

description: Every raw OWID row reaches staging (no unknown ISO codes dropped)
check_sql: SELECT r.raw_rows, s.stg_rows FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS raw_rows FROM raw.owid_energy) AS r CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS stg_rows FROM stg.owid_energy) AS s WHERE r.raw_rows <> s.stg_rows

description: Every published grid has hours, and they cover at least 98% of its span (Q5; a grid with none fails)
check_sql: SELECT g.grid_key, g.grid_code, COUNT(f.ts_utc) AS hours, DATEDIFF(HOUR, MIN(f.ts_utc), MAX(f.ts_utc)) + 1 AS span_hours FROM dw.dim_grid AS g LEFT JOIN dw.fact_grid_hourly AS f ON f.grid_key = g.grid_key WHERE g.is_published = 1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw.grid_interval AS r WHERE r.grid_code = g.grid_code) GROUP BY g.grid_key, g.grid_code HAVING COUNT(f.ts_utc) = 0 OR (DATEDIFF(HOUR, MIN(f.ts_utc), MAX(f.ts_utc)) + 1 - COUNT(f.ts_utc)) > 0.02 * (DATEDIFF(HOUR, MIN(f.ts_utc), MAX(f.ts_utc)) + 1)

description: No source interval is published twice under different files (Q5): TH one chosen row per hour, SG one copy per half-hour
check_sql: SELECT h.grid_code, CAST(h.period_end AS NVARCHAR(30)) AS at_time, h.series, COUNT(*) AS n FROM stg.singapore_halfhour AS h WHERE h.period_end IS NOT NULL GROUP BY h.grid_code, h.period_end, h.series HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 UNION ALL SELECT c.grid_code, CAST(c.ts_local AS NVARCHAR(30)), NULL, COUNT(*) FROM stg.thailand_chosen_row AS c GROUP BY c.grid_code, c.ts_local HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

description: No complete hour of system demand is negative (Q5; checked in staging, so it reports instead of crashing)
check_sql: SELECT grid_key, ts_utc, demand_mw FROM stg.grid_hourly WHERE is_complete = 1 AND demand_mw < 0

description: Every grid timestamp parses (TH dd/mm/yyyy h:mm with minute 0 or 5; SG yyyy-mm-dd|hh:mm period end)
check_sql: SELECT file_name, ts_text FROM stg.thailand_row WHERE ts_local IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT file_name, ts_text FROM stg.singapore_halfhour WHERE period_end IS NULL

description: Hours with a missing regional part are left out of the facts
check_sql: SELECT grid_key, ts_local FROM stg.grid_hourly WHERE is_complete = 0

description: Hourly demand within 30%-300% of the grid's median (Q5)
check_sql: SELECT f.grid_key, f.ts_local, f.demand_mw FROM dw.fact_grid_hourly AS f JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT grid_key, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY demand_mw) OVER (PARTITION BY grid_key) AS median_mw FROM dw.fact_grid_hourly) AS m ON m.grid_key = f.grid_key WHERE f.demand_mw < 0.3 * m.median_mw OR f.demand_mw > 3 * m.median_mw

description: The Malaysia tie doesn't import and export in the same hour (Q5). Scoped to MY: EDL (Laos) flows are gross sums over many tie lines, so both directions in one hour are normal there
check_sql: SELECT grid_key, ts_utc, counterparty, import_mw, export_mw FROM dw.fact_grid_flow_hourly WHERE counterparty = 'MY' AND import_mw > 0 AND export_mw > 0

description: A timestamp published in two files has the same value in both (Q1)
check_sql: SELECT grid_code, ts_text, series, COUNT(*) AS copies FROM raw.grid_interval GROUP BY grid_code, ts_text, series HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT file_name) > 1 AND (MIN(value) <> MAX(value) OR COUNT(value) NOT IN (0, COUNT(*)))

description: Interconnector import and export are non-negative magnitudes
check_sql: SELECT grid_key, ts_utc, counterparty, import_mw, export_mw FROM stg.grid_flow_hourly WHERE import_mw < 0 OR export_mw < 0

description: Every handbook cell is a number or a printed dash (stg cast); none is missing
check_sql: SELECT table_code, row_pos, col_pos FROM stg.handbook_cell WHERE value_text IS NULL OR (value_text <> N'-' AND value IS NULL)

description: Every state label in the handbook's by-state tables maps to a state (ref.state_alias)
check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.table_code, c.row_pos FROM stg.handbook_cell AS c LEFT JOIN ref.state_alias AS a ON a.alias = c.row_label WHERE c.table_code IN ('SAIFI_BY_STATE', 'SAIDI_BY_STATE', 'CAIDI_BY_STATE') AND c.row_label <> N'PENINSULAR MALAYSIA' AND a.alias IS NULL

description: Each state-year comes from exactly one SAIFI and one SAIDI cell (no two labels for one state)
check_sql: SELECT state_code, year, source_cells FROM stg.handbook_state_reliability WHERE source_cells <> 2

description: Every Peninsular state has SAIFI and SAIDI for every year of the SAIFI table
check_sql: SELECT s.state_code, y.year FROM dw.dim_state AS s JOIN dw.dim_region AS r ON r.region_key = s.region_key AND r.region_code = 'PEN' CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT col_year AS year FROM stg.handbook_cell WHERE table_code = 'SAIFI_BY_STATE') AS y LEFT JOIN dw.fact_state_reliability AS f ON f.state_key = s.state_key AND f.year = y.year WHERE f.state_key IS NULL OR f.saifi IS NULL OR f.saidi_min IS NULL

description: Every regional metric has exactly the expected years per region (Sarawak SAIFI/SAIDI 2015-2021 after the header remap)
check_sql: WITH expected AS (SELECT region_code, metric_code, first_year, last_year FROM (VALUES ('PEN', 'INSTALLED_MW', 2021, 2021), ('SAB', 'INSTALLED_MW', 2021, 2021), ('SAR', 'INSTALLED_MW', 2021, 2021), ('PEN', 'AVAILABLE_MW', 2021, 2021), ('SAB', 'AVAILABLE_MW', 2021, 2021), ('SAR', 'AVAILABLE_MW', 2021, 2021), ('PEN', 'ELEC_CONSUMPTION_GWH', 2015, 2021), ('SAB', 'ELEC_CONSUMPTION_GWH', 2015, 2021), ('SAR', 'ELEC_CONSUMPTION_GWH', 2015, 2021), ('PEN', 'ELEC_PER_CAPITA_KWH', 2015, 2021), ('SAB', 'ELEC_PER_CAPITA_KWH', 2015, 2021), ('SAR', 'ELEC_PER_CAPITA_KWH', 2015, 2021), ('PEN', 'POPULATION_K', 2015, 2021), ('SAB', 'POPULATION_K', 2015, 2021), ('SAR', 'POPULATION_K', 2015, 2021), ('PEN', 'SUPPLY_INTERRUPTIONS', 2010, 2022), ('SAB', 'SUPPLY_INTERRUPTIONS', 2010, 2022), ('SAR', 'SUPPLY_INTERRUPTIONS', 2010, 2022), ('PEN', 'SAIFI', 2015, 2022), ('SAB', 'SAIFI', 2015, 2022), ('SAR', 'SAIFI', 2015, 2021), ('PEN', 'SAIDI_MIN', 2015, 2022), ('SAB', 'SAIDI_MIN', 2015, 2022), ('SAR', 'SAIDI_MIN', 2015, 2021)) AS v (region_code, metric_code, first_year, last_year)), actual AS (SELECT g.region_code, f.metric_code, MIN(f.year) AS first_year, MAX(f.year) AS last_year, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(f.value) AS valued FROM dw.fact_region_annual AS f JOIN dw.dim_region AS g ON g.region_key = f.region_key GROUP BY g.region_code, f.metric_code) SELECT COALESCE(e.region_code, a.region_code) AS region_code, COALESCE(e.metric_code, a.metric_code) AS metric_code FROM expected AS e FULL JOIN actual AS a ON a.region_code = e.region_code AND a.metric_code = e.metric_code WHERE e.region_code IS NULL OR a.region_code IS NULL OR a.first_year <> e.first_year OR a.last_year <> e.last_year OR a.n <> e.last_year - e.first_year + 1 OR a.valued <> a.n

description: Handbook capacity tables add up within print rounding: p.13 rows to Total, blocks to Subtotal, Subtotals to Total; p.14 rows and columns
check_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT table_code, row_pos, col_pos, row_group, row_label, value, COALESCE(half_unit, 0) AS half_unit FROM stg.handbook_cell WHERE table_code IN ('INSTALLED_CAPACITY', 'AVAILABLE_CAPACITY')), ncol AS (SELECT table_code, MAX(col_pos) AS total_col FROM c GROUP BY table_code), row_sum AS (SELECT c.table_code, c.row_pos, SUM(CASE WHEN c.col_pos < n.total_col THEN COALESCE(c.value, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS parts, MAX(CASE WHEN c.col_pos = n.total_col THEN c.value END) AS total, SUM(c.half_unit) AS tol FROM c JOIN ncol AS n ON n.table_code = c.table_code WHERE c.row_label <> N'Share (%)' GROUP BY c.table_code, c.row_pos), block AS (SELECT p.col_pos, p.row_group, SUM(COALESCE(p.value, 0)) AS parts, MAX(s.value) AS total, SUM(p.half_unit) + MAX(s.half_unit) AS tol FROM c AS p JOIN c AS s ON s.table_code = p.table_code AND s.col_pos = p.col_pos AND s.row_group = p.row_group AND s.row_label = N'Subtotal' WHERE p.table_code = 'INSTALLED_CAPACITY' AND p.row_label <> N'Subtotal' GROUP BY p.col_pos, p.row_group), grand AS (SELECT c.table_code, c.col_pos, SUM(CASE WHEN c.row_label = N'Subtotal' OR (c.table_code = 'AVAILABLE_CAPACITY' AND c.row_label <> N'Total') THEN COALESCE(c.value, 0) END) AS parts, MAX(CASE WHEN c.row_label = N'Total' THEN c.value END) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN c.row_label = N'Subtotal' OR c.row_label = N'Total' OR c.table_code = 'AVAILABLE_CAPACITY' THEN c.half_unit END) AS tol FROM c GROUP BY c.table_code, c.col_pos) SELECT table_code, row_pos AS position, 'row' AS kind FROM row_sum WHERE total IS NULL OR ABS(parts - total) > tol UNION ALL SELECT 'INSTALLED_CAPACITY', col_pos, 'block ' + row_group FROM block WHERE total IS NULL OR ABS(parts - total) > tol UNION ALL SELECT table_code, col_pos, 'column' FROM grand WHERE total IS NULL OR ABS(parts - total) > tol

description: SAIFI, SAIDI and regional metrics are not negative
check_sql: SELECT 'state' AS kind, state_code AS code, year FROM stg.handbook_state_reliability WHERE saifi < 0 OR saidi_min < 0 UNION ALL SELECT metric_code, region_code, year FROM stg.handbook_region_metric WHERE value < 0

description: Handbook CAIDI = SAIDI / SAIFI within print rounding, by state-year, apart from the 20 cells registered in docs/reconciliation.md M4 (plan Q4.3)
check_sql: WITH p AS (SELECT row_label, col_year, MAX(CASE WHEN table_code = 'SAIDI_BY_STATE' THEN value END) AS saidi, MAX(CASE WHEN table_code = 'SAIDI_BY_STATE' THEN half_unit END) AS h_saidi, MAX(CASE WHEN table_code = 'SAIFI_BY_STATE' THEN value END) AS saifi, MAX(CASE WHEN table_code = 'SAIFI_BY_STATE' THEN half_unit END) AS h_saifi, MAX(CASE WHEN table_code = 'CAIDI_BY_STATE' THEN value END) AS caidi, MAX(CASE WHEN table_code = 'CAIDI_BY_STATE' THEN half_unit END) AS h_caidi FROM stg.handbook_cell WHERE table_code IN ('SAIDI_BY_STATE', 'SAIFI_BY_STATE', 'CAIDI_BY_STATE') GROUP BY row_label, col_year), b AS (SELECT row_label, col_year, caidi, h_caidi, (saidi - h_saidi) / (saifi + h_saifi) AS low, CASE WHEN saifi - h_saifi > 0 THEN (saidi + h_saidi) / (saifi - h_saifi) END AS high FROM p WHERE saidi IS NOT NULL AND saifi IS NOT NULL AND caidi IS NOT NULL), known AS (SELECT row_label, year FROM (VALUES (N'Pahang', 2015), (N'Pahang', 2016), (N'Pahang', 2017), (N'Pahang', 2018), (N'Perak', 2015), (N'Perak', 2016), (N'Perak', 2017), (N'Perak', 2018), (N'Perlis', 2015), (N'Perlis', 2016), (N'Perlis', 2017), (N'Perlis', 2018), (N'Pulau Pinang', 2015), (N'Pulau Pinang', 2016), (N'Pulau Pinang', 2017), (N'Pulau Pinang', 2018), (N'Terengganu', 2017), (N'WP Putrajaya (including Cyberjaya)', 2017), (N'WP Putrajaya (including Cyberjaya)', 2019), (N'PENINSULAR MALAYSIA', 2017)) AS v (row_label, year)) SELECT b.row_label, b.col_year FROM b LEFT JOIN known AS k ON k.row_label = b.row_label AND k.year = b.col_year WHERE k.row_label IS NULL AND (b.caidi + b.h_caidi < b.low OR (b.high IS NOT NULL AND b.caidi - b.h_caidi > b.high))

description: The p.83 Peninsular summary equals the by-state tables' total rows within print rounding, apart from the 3 cells registered in docs/reconciliation.md M4 (plan Q4.1)
check_sql: WITH summary AS (SELECT CASE WHEN row_label LIKE N'SAIDI%' THEN 'SAIDI_BY_STATE' WHEN row_label LIKE N'SAIFI%' THEN 'SAIFI_BY_STATE' WHEN row_label LIKE N'CAIDI%' THEN 'CAIDI_BY_STATE' END AS state_table, col_year, value, half_unit FROM stg.handbook_cell WHERE table_code = 'PEN_DIST_PERF'), total AS (SELECT table_code, col_year, value, half_unit FROM stg.handbook_cell WHERE table_code IN ('SAIDI_BY_STATE', 'SAIFI_BY_STATE', 'CAIDI_BY_STATE') AND row_label = N'PENINSULAR MALAYSIA'), known AS (SELECT state_table, year FROM (VALUES ('SAIFI_BY_STATE', 2022), ('CAIDI_BY_STATE', 2017), ('CAIDI_BY_STATE', 2022)) AS v (state_table, year)) SELECT s.state_table, s.col_year FROM summary AS s JOIN total AS t ON t.table_code = s.state_table AND t.col_year = s.col_year LEFT JOIN known AS k ON k.state_table = s.state_table AND k.year = s.col_year WHERE k.state_table IS NULL AND ((s.value IS NULL AND t.value IS NOT NULL) OR (s.value IS NOT NULL AND t.value IS NULL) OR ABS(s.value - t.value) > s.half_unit + t.half_unit)

description: Handbook per-capita rows equal total / population within 1% (p.17-19); a missing input is reported too
check_sql: WITH k AS (SELECT table_code, col_year, MAX(CASE WHEN row_label = N'Population (''000 people)**' THEN value END) AS pop, MAX(CASE WHEN row_label = N'Electricity Consumption (GWh)' THEN value END) AS gwh, MAX(CASE WHEN row_label = N'Electricity Consumption (kWh) per Capita' THEN value END) AS kwh_pc, MAX(CASE WHEN row_label = N'Final Energy Consumption (ktoe)' THEN value END) AS ktoe, MAX(CASE WHEN row_label = N'Final Energy Consumption (toe) per Capita' THEN value END) AS toe_pc FROM stg.handbook_cell WHERE table_code LIKE 'KEY[_]DATA[_]%' GROUP BY table_code, col_year) SELECT table_code, col_year FROM k WHERE pop IS NULL OR pop = 0 OR gwh IS NULL OR kwh_pc IS NULL OR ktoe IS NULL OR toe_pc IS NULL OR ABS(kwh_pc - gwh * 1000.0 / pop) > 0.01 * kwh_pc OR ABS(toe_pc - ktoe / pop) > 0.01 * toe_pc

description: raw.handbook_cell holds exactly the pinned cells per table for the loaded edition (989 for 2023): no stale or missing cells
check_sql: WITH expected AS (SELECT table_code, cells FROM (VALUES ('INSTALLED_CAPACITY', 230), ('AVAILABLE_CAPACITY', 28), ('KEY_DATA_PEN', 84), ('KEY_DATA_SAB', 84), ('KEY_DATA_SAR', 84), ('SUPPLY_INTERRUPTIONS', 39), ('PEN_DIST_PERF', 40), ('SAIDI_BY_STATE', 112), ('SAIFI_BY_STATE', 112), ('CAIDI_BY_STATE', 112), ('SABAH_DIST_PERF', 40), ('SARAWAK_DIST_PERF', 24)) AS v (table_code, cells)), actual AS (SELECT table_code, COUNT(*) AS cells FROM stg.handbook_cell GROUP BY table_code) SELECT COALESCE(e.table_code, a.table_code) AS table_code, e.cells AS expected, a.cells AS actual FROM expected AS e FULL JOIN actual AS a ON a.table_code = e.table_code WHERE e.cells IS NULL OR a.cells IS NULL OR e.cells <> a.cells

description: Capacity by fuel group sums to the printed region total (installed within 0.5 MW, available within 3.5 MW: print rounding) for every region-year
check_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT region_key, year, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_code = 'INSTALLED_MW' THEN value END) AS installed, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_code = 'AVAILABLE_MW' THEN value END) AS available FROM dw.fact_region_annual WHERE metric_code IN ('INSTALLED_MW', 'AVAILABLE_MW') GROUP BY region_key, year), f AS (SELECT region_key, year, SUM(installed_mw) AS installed, SUM(available_mw) AS available FROM dw.fact_region_capacity GROUP BY region_key, year) SELECT COALESCE(t.region_key, f.region_key) AS region_key, COALESCE(t.year, f.year) AS year FROM t FULL JOIN f ON f.region_key = t.region_key AND f.year = t.year WHERE t.region_key IS NULL OR f.region_key IS NULL OR ABS(COALESCE(f.installed, 0) - COALESCE(t.installed, -1)) > 0.5 OR ABS(COALESCE(f.available, 0) - COALESCE(t.available, -1)) > 3.5
